final: SELECT s.store_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count, COUNT(c.customer_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) AS share_of_all_customers, COUNT(c.customer_id) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM store)) AS multiple_of_average_store_count FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN customer AS c ON c.store_id = s.store_id GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY s.store_id
